title: Freelance architect, portfolio
opening: I want a portfolio site for my architecture work
persona: Leila Mansour, a freelance architect with eight years of practice. Articulate, cares about the look, answers in two or three sentences.
facts: The site is for private clients planning a house renovation or a small new house.
The one thing a visitor should do is book a first site visit by email: studio@example.com.
Three projects to show: a courtyard house in Jeddah (2024, 420 square metres), a library renovation for a school (2023), and her own apartment (2022).
The courtyard house cut cooling energy by about a third compared with the client's old house, measured over one summer.
Has professional photos of the courtyard house only; phone photos of the others.
Has a wordmark she drew in pencil. Owns the domain leilamansour.studio.
Does not want a blog, awards section, or client logos.
taste: If asked for a material or object with the right colour: rammed earth walls and the blue-grey of shade at noon. Wants the photography to carry the page. Prefers quiet, editorial layouts.

files.projects.md:
# Projects

## Courtyard House, Jeddah (2024)
420 m2. A house built around a shaded courtyard. Cooling energy about one third lower than the family's previous house, measured June to August.

## School Library Renovation (2023)
Turned a storage wing into a reading room with clerestory light.

## Own Apartment (2022)
A small apartment rebuilt around one long shelf.
